title: Affine chart comparison preserves the universal derivation
statement: Let f : X → S be a scheme morphism [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf], U and V affine opens of X and S with U contained in the inverse image of V. There exists an isomorphism T from Ω(X/S) restricted along U.fromSpec to Ω(Spec Γ(X,U)/Spec Γ(S,V)), equal to the composite of relativeDifferentialsRestrictIso, relativeDifferentialsCongr along SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec, and relativeDifferentialsCompIso. For every b in Γ(Spec Γ(X,U), top), T inverse sends d(b) to d((U.fromSpec.appIso top) inverse b). The equality uniquely determines T; no surjectivity is asserted.

source.place: Tags 01UM and 01UT; Lemma 29.33.3 (01US), differential compatibility under restriction

proof.text: Take T to be the explicitly specified composite. Its inverse on d(b) is computed in three steps: relativeDifferentialsCompIso uses relativeDifferentialsHomEquiv_symm_app_d to preserve d; equality induction for relativeDifferentialsCongr preserves d; relativeDifferentialsToRestrict_app_d computes the inverse restriction comparison as d((fromSpec.appIso top).inv b). Compose these identities. The equality defining T is reflexivity.

proof_origin.note: Lean-level expansion of the restriction compatibility in Stacks Tag 01US (Lemma 29.33.3), used in the first sentence of the proof of Tag 01UT.

from.place: compatibility of affine-chart transport with derivations

lean.statement:
theorem relativeDifferentials_affine_chart_derivation (f : X ⟶ S)
    (U : X.affineOpens) (V : S.affineOpens) (hUV : U.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) :
    ∃ T : f.relativeDifferentials.restrict U.2.fromSpec ≅
        (Spec.map (f.appLE V.1 U.1 hUV)).relativeDifferentials,
      T = f.relativeDifferentialsRestrictIso U.2.fromSpec ≪≫
        Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentialsCongr _
          (IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec f V.2 U.2 hUV).symm ≪≫
        Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentialsCompIso _ _ ∧
    ∀ b : Γ(Spec Γ(X, U.1), ⊤),
      T.inv.val.app (op ⊤)
        ((Spec.map (f.appLE V.1 U.1 hUV)).relativeDifferentialsDerivation.d b) =
          f.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.d ((U.2.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).inv b)
